name: Birds Eye Steamfresh Cut Green Beans (Microwave Steam Bag)
whyItWorks: Flash-frozen tender green beans that steam inside the sealed bag under gentle pressure. Steaming softens the outer cellulose pod walls, rendering them fork-tender, low-FODMAP, and non-bloating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave unopened bag for 4.5 minutes. Toss with a dab of butter and salt.
watchOuts: 100% pure green beans without added butter sauces or alliums.
